DEATH MASTER - Android Studio Project
Target device: Vivo Y17 (model 1901), Android 11

IMPORTANT:
- This is a starter Android app project, not a built APK.
- It provides safe shortcuts to Android settings and practical gaming tips.
- It does NOT claim zero lag, zero heat, or guaranteed FPS gains.
- Android does not allow ordinary apps to forcibly clear other apps' RAM or control CPU/GPU clocks without privileged/root access.

APK banane ke steps:
1. Computer par Android Studio install karo.
2. Android Studio > Open > is ZIP ko extract karke DeathMaster folder select karo.
3. Gradle sync complete hone do.
4. Build > Build Bundle(s) / APK(s) > Build APK(s).
5. APK app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk mein milegi.
6. APK ko apne Vivo Y17 mein transfer karke install karo. Unknown-app install permission Android khud maangega.

Agar Android Studio Gradle/JDK version error de, Android Studio ke recommended JDK (17) ko select karo.
